title: The article discusses the challenges faced by African countries in the context of international trade negotiations, particularly regarding agriculture and export subsidies. It highlights the conflicting positions of the US and the European Community (EC) and the potential impact of new agreements on African economies, especially for food importers. The text emphasizes the importance of agriculture for African nations and the need for flexibility in support measures to ensure food security. Additionally, it features a quiz section to engage readers with questions related to African economies and current events.
